$comment: Member kinds this lexicon supplies to a chant workspace (#3179). chant reads this file as data and never imports the lexicon. The Argo and Flux probes read the manifest's apiVersion and kind, so a Flux Kustomization is told apart from the kustomize one that shares its kind name. Each kind's graph block (#3179) reads the member through the k8s lexicon's member reader (src/workspace-member.ts): a kustomize member is rendered, and says rendered: false on meta.k8sMember when neither kustomize nor kubectl is installed; an Argo or Flux member is read from its manifests.

kinds.name: argo-app
kinds.description: an Argo CD Application, a manifest with apiVersion argoproj.io/* and kind Application

kinds.name: flux-kustomization
kinds.description: a Flux Kustomization, a manifest with apiVersion kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/* and kind Kustomization

kinds.name: kustomize
kinds.description: a kustomize base or overlay, with a kustomization.yaml in its directory
